title: System/370 hexadecimal floating point
summary: HFP is hexadecimal floating point, not IEEE binary floating point. Arithmetic must preserve System/370 representation, normalization, rounding/truncation and exceptions.
rules: Use explicitly sufficient NUMERIC DIGITS / arbitrary precision for intermediate mathematics.
System/370 hexadecimal normalization and architectural precision boundaries remain authoritative.
Do not use host float/double as the architectural oracle.
A separate high-precision or rigorous enclosure provider may prove the mathematics without redefining HFP encoding semantics.
